text:
jamie: LAN on the mezzanine next Friday evening? thinking low-key speedrun side tourney + handheld swap. projector + low-lag monitors. who can bring power strips / capture card / spare controllers? small prize (steam key) :grin:
maria: i'm in. can bring my BenQ projector and two long power strips. also a surge protector. :thumbsup:
devin: i can bring an Elgato HD60 S capture card and an 8-port unmanaged switch. will need a table with ~6ft clear space.
ash: (oops typo, meant ash) ash: count me for a switch and my Switch console + a few extra joycons. happy to run a MK8 mini bracket. :video_game:
sara: i'll bring snacks (vegan option) and throw in 2 steam keys for prizes :trophy: also can help run sign-ups at the door.
luca: i've got a weird pile of adapters: PS2->HDMI, Dreamcast VGA->HDMI, and a lag tester. i can bring a Dreamcast and a CRT-styled monitor if people want authenticity lol.
jamie: amazing. @maria @devin can you both bring ethernet cables (cat6) as well? thinking wired for the speedrun corner to avoid wifi lag.
maria: yep i have a bunch of cat6 and a cable tester.
devin: will add 10ft+ cat6s. also can bring some gaffer tape for cable runs.
luca: quick outlet map FYI:
```
North wall: 4 outlets (two banks)
South window: 2 outlets
Projector wall: 1 GFCI (do not overload)
Mezz row by table: extra outlet on leg
```

ash: does the mezz have folding chairs? i can bring 4 if needed. also anyone got a HDMI switch? projector only has 1 hdmi in.
maria: i can bring an HDMI switch (3 in -> 1 out).
sara: i'll scope the meeting room capacity and post a small google form for signups.
jamie: perfect. i'll make the calendar invite and pin the signup. ops-bot: can you create the event for Fri 7pm and reserve mezzanine?
ops-bot: Sure — created event "Mezzanine LAN & Speedrun" for 2024-06-07 19:00–23:00 and added the #mezzanine channel booking.
luca: also pro tip: if anyone's using older consoles bring a `small USB power bank + 5V 2A` adapter for handhelds. saves a lot of fuss.
ash: (again meant ash) ash: noted. i'll bring 4 chairs and some napkins. vegetarian snacks please @sara :salad:
jamie: thanks team — i'll post a quick checklist in the event: projector, capture card, hdmi switch, cat6, power strips, chairs, snacks. if you can bring something, reply in the event so i can cross it off. see you friday! :party_popper:
